name: Ratio Ex Nihilo #0 — The Origin Sketch
description: The original hand-drawn Metatron's Cube with Eye, created on physical paper with compass, ruler, and calculator. Mathematical calculations visible. This is where it all began. This is the genesis artifact of the Ratio Ex Nihilo symbol, representing the fusion of ancient sacred geometry with mathematical precision. Created by Dom (Strategickhaos DAO LLC founder) as the first physical manifestation of 'Reason from Nothing.'
